service.description: For Assist (insights_datasets): the admitted business datasets the user reads that Assist may ask, each with its domain owner and whether it holds costs, and for a chosen datasetId its measures, groups and filters. A dataset of costs and margins, and a cost or margin field of any dataset, is listed only for a user who holds PRODUCT_COST_VIEW; a People or unclassified dataset never. Runs nothing. Refuses a user without Insights read (INSIGHTS_VIEW_REQUIRED), a dataset that is not admitted, not theirs or not classified (DATASET_UNAVAILABLE) and a cost dataset without the permission (DATASET_RESTRICTED).

For an MCP client (insights_operations_datasets): the admitted business operations datasets the user reads and, for a chosen datasetId, its measures, groups and filters without any cost or margin field. A dataset of costs and margins, of People or payroll, or without a class is never listed, whatever the user holds (DATASET_RESTRICTED, DATASET_UNAVAILABLE). Runs nothing.

For Assist (insights_query): one aggregate over an admitted business dataset from typed choices (count, or a measure summed, averaged, least, greatest or its distinct values; up to two groups; a time grain; one filter; a range as the engine's relative or ISO dates, the last 30 days when empty), run by the report engine as the user: the dataset's admission, row filter and semantic guards apply as on a dashboard, so the rows are the user's own organizations' and an organizationPartyId narrows to one of them (refused when it is not theirs). No query language, service, index or entity is taken. A dataset of costs and margins and a cost or margin field answer only a user who holds PRODUCT_COST_VIEW. A refusal the asker can act on is the answer (available false with refusedCode and reason): DATASET_UNAVAILABLE, DATASET_RESTRICTED, FIELD_RESTRICTED, FIELD_UNAVAILABLE, VALUE_INVALID, ORGANIZATION_UNAVAILABLE, or a guard (UNIT_MIXED and the others).

For an MCP client (insights_operations_query): run#DatasetQuery's typed aggregate over a business operations dataset only, as the user and under the same admission, row filter and guards. A dataset of costs and margins (DATASET_RESTRICTED) and a cost or margin field (FIELD_RESTRICTED) are refused whatever the user holds; a People or unclassified dataset is not there (DATASET_UNAVAILABLE).

service.description: For Assist (insights_panel): a saved panel's own result as its dashboard shows it to the user, by the dashboard's definitionId and the panel's panelId (or a library panel's definitionId), a range (the last 30 days when empty) and one of the user's organizations; never a query. The engine runs the panel as the dashboard does (its saved filters and exclusions, the organization in scope, each dataset's admission and row filter), so the numbers are the dashboard's, with the panel's registered meaning. Before it runs, every dataset the panel's queries name is held to its class (DATASET_RESTRICTED for costs without PRODUCT_COST_VIEW, DATASET_UNAVAILABLE without a class or for a query that names no dataset) and a panel that reads a cost or margin field is refused (FIELD_RESTRICTED) unless the user holds PRODUCT_COST_VIEW. A panel or organization the user does not read, a repeated panel and one whose query takes a name from a variable answer available false (PANEL_UNAVAILABLE, ORGANIZATION_UNAVAILABLE). No record is returned.

For an MCP client (insights_operations_panel): run#PanelQuery's saved panel over a business operations dataset only, as the user. A panel any of whose queries reads a cost, People or unclassified dataset (DATASET_RESTRICTED, DATASET_UNAVAILABLE) or a cost or margin field (FIELD_RESTRICTED) is refused, whatever the user holds.

"Add to my dashboard" (design §1.2): the query an Assist answer ends with (its Panel line: the typed choices, read by name; anything else in the text is ignored) saved as the caller's own library panel and, when a dashboard of their own is chosen, placed on it, through AnalysisServices.store#Analysis as the caller, so Insights authoring, the dataset, each field and the engine's guards are checked as from Analysis, and the dataset's class as for the answer. A refusal is the answer (applied false with reasonCode and reason): PANEL_REQUIRED for an answer without a query, INSIGHTS_AUTHOR_REQUIRED, DATASET_UNAVAILABLE, DATASET_RESTRICTED, FIELD_RESTRICTED, DASHBOARD_NOT_OWNED, VALUE_INVALID or a guard.
